Before he was placed on IR, Chiefs LT Josh Simmons was told to leave a team meeting by coach Andy Reid and QB Patrick Mahomes. The back story from me and Mike Garafolo.
Falcons DE Za’Darius Smith (neck) and DT Gervon Dexter Sr. (hamstring) are listed as questionable and both are expected to go, sources say. Much less optimism for Olamide Zaccheaus (shoulder).

— The Broncos activated RB Jonah Coleman from IR and OLB Jonathon Cooper from the exempt list. — The 49ers activated WR Christian Kirk to make his debut. — The Vikings activated RB Jordan Mason off injured reserve to their 53-man roster.
